pass_requirement: PASS requires ALL critical gates below to be satisfied simultaneously; any unmet critical gate => DISCOVERY_FAIL (terminal)

critical_gates.insufficient_outcome: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE (terminal FAIL-class, no window extension, no relaxation)

critical_gates.rationale: the declared mechanism is a crowding UNWIND, not a carry harvest; an edge that exists only through collected funding would be a different (already refuted, FAILED_RESEARCH_MEMORY #8) family

critical_gates.metric: net profit factor = sum(positive net trade returns) / abs(sum(negative net trade returns))
annualized net Sharpe from the trade series (per-trade Sharpe * sqrt(trades_per_year), trades_per_year = N / (window_days/365))
bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of the mean net trade return
critical_gates.method: i.i.d. trade bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, frozen seed 20260915
critical_gates.requirement: CI lower bound > 0 (equivalently P(mean > 0) reported alongside)

critical_gates.metric: permutation p-value of the mean net trade return
critical_gates.method: sign-flip permutation on the realized trade returns, 10,000 draws, frozen seed 20260915

critical_gates.metric: net expectancy by chronological halves and quartiles of the common window
critical_gates.requirement: both halves > 0 AND at least 3 of 4 quartiles > 0
critical_gates.note: split boundaries are computed on the trade timeline, chronological, frozen before discovery

critical_gates.requirement: max asset share <= 60% AND max calendar-month share <= 40% AND max single-trade share <= 25%
critical_gates.note: a share is computed as component_net_PnL / total_net_PnL only when total_net_PnL > 0

critical_gates.metric: mean net trade return at frozen cost scenarios
critical_gates.note: 0 bps is reported as a diagnostic only and is never a gate

reporting_requirements: gross / funding-cashflow / cost / net decomposition, pooled and per asset
expectancy with and without funding cashflow
Sharpe, PF, expectancy, win rate, permutation p, bootstrap CI
metrics_that_are_reported_but_not_gating: max drawdown (diagnostic only, no DD gate was pre-specified for ARC-01)

fail_semantics.control_regression: if DIRECTION_CONTROL, OI_CONTROL or NULL_CONTROL satisfies all critical gates => ARC01 = DISCOVERY_FAIL (mechanism not identified)

immutability: these gates are frozen by PREREG_COMMIT and may never be relaxed, re-scoped or re-weighted after any economic execution
